text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki put on a magnificent run at 
the NHK Mile Cup.

The spectators erupted in excitement, 
captivated by the "miracle." That junior's 
mindset turned positive as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki wishes to move people's hearts 
even more. Next up is the autumn mile 
championship, the Mile CS, where even 
Senior-class racers gather—!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Target race changed to Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With strong rivals awaiting her at the 
Mile CS, the days of racing through summer 
have begun!
